@spec.fixture.parity-twin
@altitude.feature
@readiness.defined
Feature: Carrier parity twin
  - outcome: Derive equal graph and contract semantics from either carrier.

  @example-space
  Scenario: Shared vocabulary
    Given a cart containing {item:string}
    When the cart is submitted
    Then the order contains the item

  @spec.fixture.parity-twin.child
  @altitude.story
  @readiness.defined
  Scenario: One cart item
    - outcome: Bind one point of the shared vocabulary.
    Given a cart containing {item: "lamp"}
    When the cart is submitted
    Then the order contains the item

  Rule: Both carriers enter one graph shape.
